Name: Window Resize
Author: thatnzguy
Description:
Removes the minimum windowed size making it easy to have multiple SDV instances visible at one time.
This was made to allow multiple instances of the game on one screen easily for the Split Screen mod.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
[list]
[*]You can resize the window any size you like. 
[*]If you drag the window to the side of your screen on Windows it will snap and resize for easy side-by-side windows.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[size=5]Known bugs
[/size][list]
[*][b]Fixed: [/b][s]A window of less than ~1000 pixels will cause [/s]ingame[s] windows to have no background. [/s]
[*]Using the Win + Arrow keys does not automatically resize the window.
[/list]
